analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($451.10) vs SMA5/20/50 ($401.16/$393.15/$398.42) — trading above short/mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($398.46/$432.49) — indicating strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (49.4%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.7→71.8) + overbought signal + strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1.2070→4.4331) + improving trend + confirmed trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $422.16) + breaking above upper band with 14.75% band width expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($438.68) + based on Pivot S1 ($396.74) and SMA200 ($432.49).
· Swing resistance ($456.16) + potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + indicating recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.30x vs 5-day average) + high confidence in current move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + consider additional buy entry upon breaking $456.16.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가 대비 현재가 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴을 형성하고 있으며, 볼린저밴드 상단을 돌파하며 강한 상승 모멘텀을 보여주고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The price is forming a Higher Low pattern relative to the 5-day low, and is showing strong upward momentum by breaking above the upper Bollinger Band.
keyPoints: 3일 연속 상승세와 함께 거래량 3.3배 급증으로 상승 모멘텀 강화.
RSI 과매수 진입 및 MACD 강세 확산 지속으로 매수세 유입 확인.
스윙 저항선 $456.16 돌파 시 추가 상승 가능성.
keyPointsEn: 3 consecutive days of gains with a 3.3x volume surge reinforcing upward momentum.
Confirmation of buying pressure with RSI entering overbought and MACD bullish expansion continuing.
Potential for further upside upon breaking swing resistance at $456.16.
analysis.riskNote: RSI 과매수 구간 진입으로 단기 차익 실현 매물이 나올 수 있으나, MACD 강세 확산과 거래량 급증이 이를 상쇄하고 있다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: While RSI entering overbought territory may lead to short-term profit-taking, the MACD bullish expansion and volume surge are offsetting this risk.
analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 매수 판단 유지. RSI 과매수 진입 및 MACD 강세 확산 지속, 거래량 3.3배 급증으로 상승 추세 강화.
